products.title: Bamboo Palm Plant
products.description: Its lush green foliage swaying daintily in the breeze is sure to remind you of tropical resorts. The stunning green leaves grow directly from the stem and over time the spread of the plant increases to fill up the pot. An excellent air purifier the bamboo palm is easy to grow and maintain, it makes a great centerpiece in a quirky pot.
